concepts.label: Mid
concepts.description: Midpoint of best yes-bid and yes-ask. Untradeable reference price.

concepts.label: Spread
concepts.description: Best ask − best bid (¢). Wide spreads = poor liquidity; prefer postOnly.

concepts.label: Crossed book
concepts.description: Transient book state (yesBid + noBid > 100). Do not treat mid as tradeable.

concepts.label: Avg volume (Fp)
concepts.description: Mean resolved Kalshi contract volume over trading appearances (player_profiles). Not poly; not a single-tick kalshi_volume.

concepts.label: Yes price ¢
concepts.description: Limit price for YES contracts, 1–99¢. NO price = 100 − yes.

concepts.label: Balance
concepts.description: Available-to-trade cash. Does not include value locked in open positions.

concepts.label: Portfolio value
concepts.description: Current mark value of all held positions, separate from cash balance.

concepts.label: Position
concepts.description: Signed contracts: positive = long YES, negative = long NO (Kalshi convention).

concepts.label: Exposure
concepts.description: Cash at risk in this market at current marks.

concepts.label: Realized P&L
concepts.description: Locked-in profit/loss from closed trades in this market.

concepts.label: Fees paid
concepts.description: Total exchange fees paid in this market, all time.

concepts.label: Remaining
concepts.description: Contracts still working on the book (not yet filled or canceled).

concepts.label: Fill count
concepts.description: Contracts already executed from this order.

concepts.label: Taker
concepts.description: True = crossed the spread (taker fee); false = rested on book (maker fee, lower).

concepts.label: Fee ¢
concepts.description: Exchange fee on this fill. Maker < taker — postOnly orders target maker fees.

concepts.label: Post-only
concepts.description: Maker-first: order rests on book or is rejected; never crosses the spread.

concepts.label: Dry-run
concepts.description: Simulated order — no funds move, no API write. Live requires explicit opt-in.

concepts.label: Shadow min signals
concepts.description: Gate: minimum shadow signals before a program may graduate to pilot.

concepts.label: Kill Brier drift %
concepts.description: Gate: kill program if Brier score drifts this % above baseline.

concepts.label: Graduation edge ¢/fill
concepts.description: Gate: realized edge per fill needed for pilot→live.

concepts.label: League
concepts.description: Professional circuit derived from Kalshi series (ATP, WTA, Challenger, ITF).
concepts.featurePurpose: schedule

concepts.label: Surface
concepts.description: Court type: Hard, Clay, Grass, Carpet (from event or tournament seed).
concepts.featurePurpose: schedule

concepts.label: Tier
concepts.description: Competition level (GS, 1000, 500, 250, CH, ITF15–100, …).

concepts.label: Round
concepts.description: Match round within the tournament (R16, QF, SF, F, …).

concepts.label: Series
concepts.description: Kalshi series ticker family (e.g. KXATPMATCH).
concepts.featurePurpose: schedule

concepts.label: Gender
concepts.description: Competition gender classification on the desk export.
concepts.featurePurpose: schedule

concepts.label: Age group
concepts.description: Age band when present (junior/senior); often empty on tour.
concepts.featurePurpose: schedule

concepts.label: Match UUID
concepts.description: Stable match identity for desk joins.
concepts.featurePurpose: identity

concepts.label: Event ticker
concepts.description: Kalshi event ticker (market grouping key).
concepts.featurePurpose: identity

concepts.label: Timestamp
concepts.description: Snapshot capture time for the desk row.
concepts.featurePurpose: provenance

concepts.label: Player A
concepts.description: Side A player display name on the desk row.
concepts.featurePurpose: identity

concepts.label: Player B
concepts.description: Side B player display name on the desk row.
concepts.featurePurpose: identity

concepts.label: Title
concepts.description: Match / event title string on the desk export.
concepts.featurePurpose: schedule

concepts.label: Kalshi µ
concepts.description: Kalshi mid (implied probability cents) on the desk snapshot.
concepts.featurePurpose: market

concepts.label: Kalshi spread
concepts.description: Kalshi bid–ask spread on the desk snapshot.
concepts.featurePurpose: market

concepts.label: Kalshi volume
concepts.description: Kalshi contract volume on the desk tick (not player-profile average).
concepts.featurePurpose: market

concepts.label: Poly mid
concepts.description: Polymarket mid price, cents; null when venue absent.
concepts.featurePurpose: market

concepts.label: Poly volume
concepts.description: Polymarket volume USD; null = venue absent, 0 = joined with zero trades.
concepts.featurePurpose: market

concepts.label: Pinnacle no-vig
concepts.description: Pinnacle no-vig probability in cents; null when unavailable.
concepts.featurePurpose: market

concepts.label: Pinnacle source
concepts.description: mock | live — origin of pinny_no_vig.
concepts.featurePurpose: provenance

concepts.label: Elo prob
concepts.description: Elo win probability for player A (0–1); interpret with elo_source.
concepts.featurePurpose: model

concepts.label: Elo source
concepts.description: model | fallback_50 | missing — provenance of elo_prob.
concepts.featurePurpose: provenance

concepts.label: Blend fair ¢
concepts.description: Blended fair price in cents (core priced output).
concepts.featurePurpose: model

concepts.label: Eff edge
concepts.description: Effective edge vs blend (cents); tick-bound, can drift.
concepts.featurePurpose: model

concepts.label: Liquidity OK
concepts.description: Desk liquidity gate (necessary, not sufficient for tradable).
concepts.featurePurpose: gate

concepts.label: Total volume USD
concepts.description: Combined venue volume in USD for the match snapshot.
concepts.featurePurpose: market

concepts.label: Multi-venue
concepts.description: Whether more than one venue is joined on the row.
concepts.featurePurpose: gate

concepts.label: Arb hint
concepts.description: Directional arb signal (kalshi-cheap | poly-cheap | none | watch).
concepts.featurePurpose: model

concepts.label: Arb actionable
concepts.description: Hard arb gate (net edge > 0 on real venue-vs-venue).
concepts.featurePurpose: gate

concepts.label: RPS flag
concepts.description: Research process signal flag on the desk row.
concepts.featurePurpose: model

concepts.label: Graph divergence
concepts.description: Graph/model divergence indicator on the desk export.
concepts.featurePurpose: model

concepts.label: Research flag
concepts.description: Research gating reason (e.g. DATA_INCOMPLETE, thin-data).
concepts.featurePurpose: gate

concepts.label: Export note
concepts.description: Per-row provenance string (e.g. mock pinny caveat).
concepts.featurePurpose: provenance

concepts.label: Player profiles
concepts.description: Derived from event-store player_profiles (SSOT). Rebuild: bun run tennis:profiles:build.

concepts.label: Last seen
concepts.description: Epoch millis of latest event start for this player. Capped ≤ now. Event-store ms.

concepts.label: Profiles source
concepts.description: warehouse = rows from event-store; seed = unavailable / fixture path.

concepts.label: Coverage
concepts.description: Data completeness for a tour/surface slice (events with books, links, scores).

concepts.label: Surface edge
concepts.description: Dampened percentage-point edge from each player's historical surface win rates vs the match surface.

concepts.label: Reset filters
concepts.description: Clear all active Events facet selections and sort order.

concepts.label: Tennis board
concepts.description: Real-time match monitor: open Kalshi markets with filters, surface edge, and player profiles.

concepts.label: Scanner
concepts.description: Price divergence alert: when market mid deviates from model fair by more than threshold.

concepts.label: Divergence
concepts.description: Cents difference between market price and model fair price.

concepts.label: Edge score
concepts.description: Composite signal strength: divergence weighted by liquidity and model confidence.

concepts.label: Model suspect
concepts.description: Flag when model inputs are stale, incomplete, or conflict with market consensus.

concepts.label: Tournament
concepts.description: Filter matches by tournament / competition name.

concepts.label: Country
concepts.description: Filter by tournament or player nationality code/name.

concepts.label: When
concepts.description: Time window filter: live, today, next 24h, this week.

concepts.label: Liquidity
concepts.description: Filter by quote presence: priced or actively trading.

concepts.label: Min 24h vol
concepts.description: Minimum trailing volume gate for board rows (desk liquidity).

concepts.label: Min surface edge
concepts.description: Minimum surface-edge points required to keep a match on the board.

concepts.label: Sort
concepts.description: Ordering of the match list: start time, volume, or name.

concepts.label: Unclassified
concepts.description: Placeholder when a value cannot be mapped to a known category.

concepts.label: Coverage
concepts.description: Data completeness badge: Kalshi-only, Polymarket-only, or hybrid.

concepts.label: Poly
concepts.description: Polymarket market link status: linked or unlinked.

concepts.label: Event status
concepts.description: Match lifecycle: Scheduled, Live, or Ended.

concepts.label: Events
concepts.description: Number of matches in the current filtered view.

concepts.label: Total volume
concepts.description: Aggregated volume across the filtered match set.

concepts.label: Scanner signal
concepts.description: Abstract scanner / divergence-alert concept used by live board UI.

concepts.label: Price divergence
concepts.description: Abstract market-vs-model divergence concept.

concepts.label: Edge score
concepts.description: Abstract composite edge strength concept.

concepts.label: Model suspect
concepts.description: Abstract model-trust flag concept.

concepts.label: Poly Dropout
concepts.description: kalshiOnly % exceeds threshold (>30% default) for N logger cycles. Polymarket matching failing.

concepts.label: Volume Gap
concepts.description: midOnly exceeds threshold (>10 default) for N cycles. Many mids but zero volume — stale volume_fp.

concepts.label: Poly Feed Frozen
concepts.description: polyMatched=0 for N consecutive cycles. Polymarket feed completely frozen.

concepts.label: Feed Stale
concepts.description: No snapshots within staleness-threshold-ms (120s). Logger stuck or crashed.

concepts.label: Price Divergence
concepts.description: Kalshi mid deviates from Poly implied prob > divergence-cents (15¢). Cross-venue mispricing.

concepts.label: Alert Resolution
concepts.description: Auto-sent when active alert clears. Includes duration, replies original, clears debounce.

concepts.label: Alert Delivery
concepts.description: Telegram (HTML, threaded, keyboard CRITICAL), Discord/Slack webhook, console stderr.

concepts.label: Alert Severity
concepts.description: CRITICAL: feed down (keyboard). WARNING: degraded. INFO: informational, silent.

concepts.label: Color Palette
concepts.description: Venue and domain colors with WCAG contrast audited. SSOT: src/lib/color/. See docs/COLORS.md + public/registry/color-system.json.

concepts.label: Open matches
concepts.description: Count of active Kalshi events with tradable markets and non-crossed books.

concepts.label: Board volume
concepts.description: Sum of 24-hour trading volume across all live board markets in USD.

concepts.label: Store link rate
concepts.description: Percentage of events successfully enriched with cross-market odds from Polymarket and Pinnacle.

concepts.label: Book watches
concepts.description: Count of events with active WebSocket book price monitoring.

concepts.label: Player profiles
concepts.description: Number of players with computed Elo ratings and player profiles in the index.

concepts.label: Live scores
concepts.description: Count of events currently receiving live score updates from the ITF Stadion feed.

concepts.label: RPS warnings
concepts.description: Count of events flagged with RPS (price-smoothed) anomaly warnings on the live board.

concepts.label: Graph divergence
concepts.description: Count of events where Elo or odds graph signal deviates from market mid price beyond threshold.

concepts.label: Elite conviction
concepts.description: Maximum legacy conviction edge score retained for dashboard compatibility; use effective edge for current decisions.

concepts.label: Price archive
concepts.description: Count of price snapshots stored in the archive table.

concepts.label: Archive Elo fair
concepts.description: Count of price snapshot rows with Elo fair probability populated.

concepts.label: Server errors
concepts.description: Count of logger error events recorded in the last 24 hours.

concepts.label: Top edge
concepts.description: Maximum effective edge observed across all live board events.

concepts.label: Median spread
concepts.description: Median bid-ask spread across all live board events in cents.

concepts.label: Tight markets
concepts.description: Count of events where the bid-ask spread is below the liquidity threshold and both sides are non-null.

concepts.label: Scanner alerts
concepts.description: Count of active price divergence scanner flags on the live board.

concepts.label: Operator ready
concepts.description: Partner cleared for live trading — handshake complete, operator can run desk.

concepts.label: Onboarding
concepts.description: Partner in setup flow — CODE registered or forum wiring in progress.

concepts.label: Incomplete
concepts.description: Partner setup missing required fields or blocked gates.

concepts.label: Paused
concepts.description: Partner temporarily suspended — no FUND pressure.

concepts.label: Legal book
concepts.description: State-licensed / US-regulated sportsbook.

concepts.label: Offshore book
concepts.description: Non-US regulated retail sportsbook.

concepts.label: PPH desk
concepts.description: Pay-per-head bookmaking service.

concepts.label: Crypto book
concepts.description: Cryptocurrency-accepting / crypto-settled sportsbook.

concepts.label: Venmo
concepts.description: Venmo peer-to-peer transfer funding rail.

concepts.label: Crypto
concepts.description: Cryptocurrency transfer funding rail.

concepts.label: Wire transfer
concepts.description: Bank wire transfer funding rail.

concepts.label: Credit line
concepts.description: Seat-extended / house credit line (not a cash deposit).

concepts.label: Ready
concepts.description: Out active and accepting bets.

concepts.label: Deferred
concepts.description: Out pending activation / warming.

concepts.label: Paused
concepts.description: Out temporarily inactive.

concepts.label: Deposit received
concepts.description: Incoming funds confirmed against a funding target.

concepts.label: Withdrawal processed
concepts.description: Outgoing funds sent.

concepts.label: Credit extended
concepts.description: Credit line issued to partner.

concepts.label: Free-roll applied
concepts.description: Risk-free stake / freeplay percent applied.

concepts.label: Settlement confirmed
concepts.description: Bet settled, funds moved — factory mirror event only.

concepts.label: Partner registered
concepts.description: Factory mirror: partner CODE registered (onboarding).

concepts.label: Partner phase change
concepts.description: Factory mirror: partner lifecycle phase changed.

concepts.label: Out created
concepts.description: Factory mirror: new out row created on the seat desk.

concepts.label: Out status change
concepts.description: Factory mirror: out status transitioned.

concepts.label: Deposit received event
concepts.description: Factory mirror: deposit confirmed (soft ledger stays in ct).

concepts.label: Deposit allocated
concepts.description: Factory mirror: deposit allocated to an out / rail.

concepts.label: Credit extended event
concepts.description: Factory mirror: credit line extended.

concepts.label: Free-roll applied event
concepts.description: Factory mirror: free-roll / freeplay applied.

concepts.label: Settlement processed
concepts.description: Factory mirror: settlement confirmed.

concepts.label: Telegram invite sent
concepts.description: Factory mirror: Telegram invite dispatched for partner forum.

concepts.label: Telegram message pinned
concepts.description: Factory mirror: Telegram message pinned (desk home / accounting).

concepts.label: Surface
concepts.description: Named portal, endpoint, board, or artifact being described or checked.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Hostname
concepts.description: Network host resolved from a surface URL, without its protocol, port, path, or query.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Port
concepts.description: Network port resolved from a surface URL, using the protocol default when no port is explicit.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Status
concepts.description: Observed operational outcome reported by a source; status is evidence and does not encode presentation color.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Tone
concepts.description: Presentation token derived from status and evidence; tone controls color consistently without replacing status.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Kind
concepts.description: Operational classification of a surface or check; distinct from the glossary concept kind used for provenance.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Plane
concepts.description: Control-plane ownership boundary responsible for producing or operating a surface.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Source
concepts.description: Canonical path or location from which the displayed evidence was read.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Version
concepts.description: Declared schema, runtime, proof, or artifact revision attached to the displayed evidence.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Resources
concepts.description: Governed links that connect a surface to its artifact, package owner, and human documentation.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Artifact
concepts.description: Produced evidence consumed, maintained, delivered, or verified by the portal.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Package
concepts.description: Owning or producing package mapped to a portal surface or artifact.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Semantic type
concepts.description: Stable data role of a concept; distinct from operational kind and from its visual UI role.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Limit account
concepts.description: Partner-tree account whose observed sportsbook limits, jurisdiction binding, and monitoring evidence are evaluated together. Same subject as ops.limits.node (UI says account; wire says node_id).
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Tree node
concepts.description: One row in tree_nodes identified by TreeNodeId / node_id. Synonym for limit account; not an AI agent and not the Agent API.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Partner tree
concepts.description: Full hierarchy of partner accounts (partner → agent → sub_agent) used for limit, license, and downline context.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Downline
concepts.description: Descendant accounts under a partner in the partner tree (agents and sub-agents), excluding the partner root itself.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Role type
concepts.description: Position of a tree node in the partner hierarchy. Wire field node_type: partner, agent, or sub_agent.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Partner
concepts.description: Top-of-tree role in the partner hierarchy (node_type partner). Owns downline agents and sub-agents.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Downline agent
concepts.description: Betting downline role in the partner tree (node_type agent). Not an HTTP Agent API client and not a Cursor/AI automation agent.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Sub-agent
concepts.description: Further-downline role under an agent in the partner tree (node_type sub_agent). Still a limit account, not an automation agent.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Account limit profile
concepts.description: Read model joining a limit account to its operating profile, geography, licenses, policies, observations, and trace evidence.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Jurisdiction policy
concepts.description: Effective state-scoped or account-scoped wagering rule projected from the regulatory limit authority.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Policy code
concepts.description: Stable internal code identifying a jurisdiction, sport, market, and optional account override without claiming an external legal citation.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Limit monitoring status
concepts.description: Evidence-derived account state: monitored, attention, blocked, or incomplete; presentation tone is derived separately.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Limit evidence trace
concepts.description: Time-ordered record of profile, license, policy, observed-limit, change, and blocked-wager evidence for one account.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Effective limit
concepts.description: Limit value currently applicable at an account, sportsbook, sport, market, bet-type, and jurisdiction intersection.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Partner limit patterns
concepts.description: Evidence surface grouping recent limit movement by partner tree, sportsbook, jurisdiction, and ZIP prefix.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Limit change direction
concepts.description: Observed direction of a sportsbook limit change relative to the immediately previous limit.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Market phase
concepts.description: Trading phase on a limit observation: pregame or live (in-play). Bet structure is governed separately by ops.limits.multi_structure.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Sport
concepts.description: Hierarchy root for the observed limit row. Values are the competition-catalog / scrape-wire SPORT_KEYS (SSOT with glossary sport.*).
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: League or tour
concepts.description: League, tour, or sanctioning body for a limit observation. Values ⊆ competition-catalog LEAGUE_KEYS (audited by schema:audit).
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Competition tier
concepts.description: Specific level within a league or tour. Values ⊆ COMPETITION_KEYS (audited by schema:audit).
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Event host country
concepts.description: ISO alpha-2 country where the event is played. This dimension owns the displayed country flag; global tours do not.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Market type
concepts.description: Bet market family on the limit row. Values are scrape-wire SCRAPE_MARKET_KEYS (regulation + extended); domain definitions under market.* / scrape.market.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Multi / parlay structure
concepts.description: How selections combine: straight single, or multi (parlay) with legs. Domain definitions live under multi.* in the glossary.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Limit delta
concepts.description: Signed difference between the new sportsbook limit and its immediately previous value in USD.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Multi-factor influence
concepts.description: Normalized contribution score joining activity, profitability, risk, compliance, and sportsbook context for a limit change.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Pattern evidence coverage
concepts.description: Percentage of expected hierarchy, geography, license, score, and proof connections present in the limit-pattern read model.
concepts.featurePurpose: Cross-portal semantic field contract.

concepts.label: Limit raise prediction
concepts.description: Forecast of the probability and expected magnitude of a future limit raise using frequency, trend, influence, and time-window features.

concepts.label: Match winner
concepts.description: Outright winner market (moneyline / 1X2 / H2H). Wire key match_winner on limit and policy rows.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Point spread
concepts.description: Margin-of-victory market. Regulatory and limit wire key is spread; handicap is a synonym.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Total
concepts.description: Over/under market on combined points, goals, or games. Wire key over_under on limit and policy rows.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Player prop
concepts.description: Bet on an individual player's statistical performance within an event (points, goals, aces, …).
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Team prop
concepts.description: Bet on a team's statistical performance within an event, distinct from match winner or spread.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Futures
concepts.description: Bet on a future outcome such as a league champion, award winner, or season-long standing.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: In-play
concepts.description: Market phase for wagers placed after an event has started. Aligns with limit market phase live.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Spread (wire)
concepts.description: Regulatory wire key for point-spread markets. Prefer market.point_spread in new glossary links.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Over/under (wire)
concepts.description: Regulatory wire key for total markets. Prefer market.total in new glossary links.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Normalized odds
concepts.description: Odds converted to a comparable probability on the 0.00–1.00 scale across books and prediction venues.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Overround
concepts.description: Sum of implied probabilities across mutually exclusive outcomes; the bookmaker margin (vig) above 1.00.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Arbitrage gap
concepts.description: Price gap between venues for the same event/outcome that can imply a locked cross-venue edge when below 1.00 combined.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Venue comparison
concepts.description: Side-by-side price comparison for the same event and market across sportsbooks and prediction markets (Kalshi, Polymarket, …).
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Unified price
concepts.description: Single normalized price for an event/outcome derived from multiple venue quotes after vig and format normalization.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Bookmaker odds
concepts.description: Odds quote evidence from a specific sportsbook at a point in time, used for limit context and cross-market analytics.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Prediction market price
concepts.description: Price evidence from a prediction venue such as Kalshi or Polymarket for the same underlying event/outcome.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Parlay
concepts.description: Single wager linking multiple selections (legs); all legs must win for the parlay to pay. UI shorthand: multi.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Parlay leg
concepts.description: Individual selection inside a parlay / accumulator; each leg is a market outcome on an event.
concepts.featurePurpose: Governed sports betting hierarchy, market, and data-product concept.

concepts.label: Scrape wire taxonomy
concepts.description: Canonical book, state, sport, league, and market keys that all Tier 4 sportsbook agents normalize vendor wire onto before LimitObservation write.
concepts.featurePurpose: Tier 4 scrape wire taxonomy — unified state/sport/market normalization.

concepts.label: Scrape sportsbook
concepts.description: US top-10 Tier 4 sportsbook fleet on the scrape wire (SportsbookId). Aliases (dk, czr, espn_bet, …) normalize here.
concepts.featurePurpose: Tier 4 scrape wire taxonomy — unified state/sport/market normalization.

concepts.label: Scrape sport key
